request.text: I am looking for a stylish laptop under 2 lakhs which has good battery life

reply.notice: Prices are a saved snapshot from 10 Nov 2026, not live. Specs are imported listing data that no person has checked yet. Web reviews are fetched live when you ask.
reply.footer: LapFit shows recorded facts with their dates. It is a second opinion, not a purchase recommendation or a guarantee.

blocks.text: I can't rank by "a stylish laptop" directly, so I used general performance and your budget.

Looks and design are not recorded in the catalog. As a stand-in I counted how many owners praised the looks in their reviews. Treat it as a guide, not a fact about the design. I have no colour data yet.
Real battery life is not in the catalog. I used what owners reported about the battery.
